desc: a 6-second tunnel on the guest's side of a relay room (TTYD_NET_FAULTS blackout_ms: nothing read or sent, the connection kept, the bytes waiting): under the 8-second quiet time, so neither game drops the connection or reconnects; the guest catches up with what waited and both end with the same progress (the host's own end, at frame 6000 before the guest's, is the one 'player 1 left the room' allowed)

log_must_not: net: connection to a player lost
net: connection lost \(player 2 left the room\)

log_must: \[netfaults\] blackout: nothing in or out at frame
log_must_not: net: connection lost \((?!player 1 left the room\))
f(?:[0-3]\d{3}|\d{1,3}) net: connection lost \(player 1 left the room\)
